description: Per-player turn file (the .m equivalent) returned by GET /games/{game-id}/turns/{year}/players/{player-id}. The engine derives this from its host-side ground truth via a single choke point so no host-only data leaks. See stars-reborn-design/docs/architecture.rst (Per-Player Visibility).

planet-unobserved.description: A planet the player has never observed. Only identity (id, name, position) is known — these come from the shared .xy data. No contents fields appear.
planet-unobserved.title: PlanetUnobserved

planet-observed.description: A planet the player has observed. Contents fields hold values as of the last scan; years-since-last-scan = 0 means current ground truth, anything higher is stale (see Information Staleness in stars-reborn-design/docs/mechanics/scanning.rst).

years-since-last-scan.description: 0 = currently in penetrating-scan range (or owned). Higher = stale snapshot.

temperature.description: Temperature in °C, snapped to 4° steps in [-200, 200].

owner.description: Player id of the current owner. Absent ⇒ observed but unowned (e.g. abandoned colony).

value.description: Planet value computed against the viewing player's race. 0..100 = habitable; negative = red (capped at -45). Different players see different values for the same planet.

resources-per-year.description: Resources the planet generates per year: floor(population / resource-production) + operated-factories x factory-production (see docs/mechanics/production.rst). A derived value recomputed each turn, present only for a planet the viewing player owns. Absent when the engine cannot compute it (e.g. an Alternate Reality race, whose economy model is not yet implemented).

build-queue.description: The planet's production queue, in build order. Present only for planets the viewing player owns (production is private); empty array when the queue is empty.

route-target.description: Planet id this owned planet routes arriving fleets to (the "Route To" destination), or null for no route. Present only for owned planets, since routing is private to the owner.

planet-observed.title: PlanetObserved

build-item.description: One entry in an owned planet's production queue. build-object-id indexes the buildable registry (GET /model/buildables): 7=factory, 8=mine, 9=defenses, 1024+N=design slot N. See docs/mechanics/production.rst.

build-quantity.description: Number of this item remaining to build.

build-progress.description: Percent complete (0..99) of the item at the head of this entry; 0 for a freshly queued item.

estimated-years-to-complete.description: Projected years to finish this entry at the planet's current output. Absent until the cost/output model lands.

build-item.title: BuildItem

slot-assignment.description: One filled hull slot in a ship design: which component sits in which slot, and how many.

slot-index.description: Index into the hull's slots array (GET /model/ships/hulls). Identifies which physical slot is filled.

part-id.description: Component installed in this slot; indexes the technology catalog (GET /model/technologies).

count.description: How many of the part occupy this slot; bounded by the hull slot's max-count.

slot-assignment.title: SlotAssignment

ship-design.description: A ship or starbase design owned by the viewing player. Drives the Ship Designer Existing Designs view and the production queue (a build-item with build-object-id 1024+slot refers to the ship design in that slot). See docs/mechanics/ship_design.rst.

slot.description: Design slot index. Ship designs occupy slots 0-15, starbase designs 0-9 in a parallel space (disambiguated by kind). Production queue items reference a ship design as build-object-id 1024+slot.

kind.description: Whether this is a ship or a starbase design; selects whether hull-id is a ship-hull or starbase-hull id.

name.description: Player-assigned design name shown in the Existing Designs list.

hull-id.description: Hull this design is built on. A ship-hull id (GET /model/ships/hulls) when kind=ship, a starbase-hull id when kind=starbase.

slot-assignments.description: Filled slots. Empty slots are omitted. A complete ship design fills at least its required engine slot.

built-count.description: Number of ships of this design currently in existence across the player's fleets. Drives the 'N of N' badge; when > 0 the design cannot be edited (its slot is locked until the last ship is gone).

ship-design.title: ShipDesign

planet-intel.description: A single planet entry in the player's turn file. Untagged on the wire: clients distinguish observed vs. unobserved by the presence of contents fields.
planet-intel.title: PlanetIntel

turn-message.description: One message shown in the player's turn for this year. Messages are per-turn (regenerated each year, not accumulated). Mirrors the design-target turn-message shape in schemas/turn.json.

id.description: Position of this message within this turn's list, 0-based. Stable only within the turn file it appears in.

message.description: The rendered display text. The original client caps a single message at 1024 characters; the engine keeps messages well under that.

message-type.description: Stable tag for the kind of message (the turn-message-type family in schemas/turn.json), e.g. 'PlanetProductionQueueEmpty'. A client treats it as an opaque tag and never derives importance from it.

related-object.description: Universe-wide space-object id (a planet or fleet) this message is about — the client's 'Goto' subject. Absent for a message with no on-map subject.

related-battle.description: Id of the battle this message reports on, when it is a combat message. Absent otherwise.

important.description: Whether this message survives the player's 'hide unimportant messages' filter. The engine classifies importance; a client never derives it from message-type.

turn-message.title: TurnMessage

turn-score.description: The viewing player's F10 score breakdown for this year (see docs/mechanics/victory.rst). Own score only; opponents' scores and ranks are gated on the public-player-scores game flag, which is not modelled yet. Each category carries its raw count and the points it contributes; `total` is their sum. Categories for objects the engine does not model yet read 0 (starbases, #147; ships, #155).

total.description: Total F10 score: the sum of every category's points.

planet-count.description: Number of planets the player owns.

starbase-count.description: Starbases owned (Orbital Forts excluded). 0 until the starbase model lands (#147).

unarmed-count.description: Unarmed ships (power rating 0). 0 until the fleet model lands (#155).

escort-count.description: Escort ships (power rating 1..1999). 0 until the fleet model lands (#155).

capital-count.description: Capital ships (power rating >= 2000). 0 until the fleet model lands (#155).

tech-level-sum.description: Sum of the player's six tech-field levels.

resource-amount.description: Annual resources the player's planets generate.

turn-score.title: TurnScore

game-id.description: UUID v4 string identifying the game.

homeworld-id.description: Planet id of the viewing player's homeworld. Absent if the player has no homeworld (e.g. eliminated).

planets.description: Every planet in the universe, sorted by id. Each entry is either observed (full contents) or unobserved (identity only).

ship-designs.description: The viewing player's own ship and starbase designs. Always the player's own designs (never another player's). Empty until the engine models designs.

messages.description: This player's messages for this turn, in display order. Per-turn: regenerated every year, never accumulated. Carries only messages the engine can produce from the state it models today (e.g. an empty production queue); event messages (combat, bombing, colonisation, growth, mining, research, minefields, packets, random events) are added as turn resolution and each mechanic land.

race.description: The viewing player's own race (PRT, LRTs, hab preferences, economy, research costs). Always the player's own race, never another player's. Absent only when the player has no race (e.g. a phantom/unknown player id).

title: PlayerView
